translations.literal: In the Chengzong era bandits held the land of Boluotuo'er; he was ordered to lead troops to punish them, captured more than three thousand men, executed their chieftain, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Chengzong, when bandits seized Boluotuo'er, he was ordered to suppress them, took more than three thousand prisoners, executed their chieftain, and returned.

sentences.zh: 奉命同客省使拔都兒等往八兒胡之地，以前所獲人口畜牧悉給其主。

translations.literal: Under orders he went with the guest-reception envoy Badou'er and others to the land of Ba'erhu, and gave all the people and herds previously captured entirely to their owners.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered with Guest Reception Envoy Badou'er and others to Ba'erhu, where he restored all the people and livestock previously captured to their rightful owners.

sentences.zh: 軍還，帝特賜鈔一百錠。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the emperor specially granted one hundred ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return the emperor specially granted him one hundred ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 武宗居潛邸，亦以銀酒器賞之。

translations.literal: When the Wuzong dwelt in the hidden residence, he also rewarded him with silver wine vessels.
translations.idiomatic: While still heir apparent, the Wuzong also rewarded him with silver wine vessels.

sentences.zh: 至大二年，立左阿速衛，授本衛僉事，賜金符。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhida the Left Alan Guard was established; he was appointed commissioner of that guard and granted the golden tally.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhida 2, when the Left Alan Guard was established, he was made its commissioner and granted the golden tally.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年，從湘寧王北征，以功賜一珠虎符。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangqing he followed the Prince of Xiangning on the northern campaign and for merit was granted the one-pearl tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 2 he followed the Prince of Xiangning on the northern campaign and received the one-pearl tiger tally for his service.

sentences.zh: 乞台，察台氏。

translations.literal: Qitai was of the Chatai clan.
translations.idiomatic: Qitai belonged to the Chatai clan.

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年為欽察衛百戶，從土土哈征叛王失烈吉及乃顏有功，賜金符，陞千戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan he was a hundred-household commander of the Qincha Guard; he followed Tutuha in campaigning against the rebel princes Shilieji and Nayan with merit, was granted the golden tally, and was raised to thousand-household commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 24 he was a hundred-household commander of the Qincha Guard; he followed Tutuha against the rebel princes Shilieji and Nayan, earned the golden tally, and was promoted to thousand-household commander.

sentences.zh: 從征忽剌出，戰于阿里台之地。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Hulachu and fought at the place Alitai.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned against Hulachu and fought at Alitai.

sentences.zh: 元貞二年，以疾卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanzhen he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He died of illness in the second year of Yuanzhen.

sentences.zh: 子哈贊赤襲職，從創兀兒於魁烈兒之地，與哈荅安戰有功。

translations.literal: His son Hazanchi succeeded to the post; he followed Chuangwu'er at the place Kuilie'er and fought Hada'an with merit.
translations.idiomatic: His son Hazanchi succeeded him; he followed Chuangwu'er at Kuilie'er and distinguished himself in battle against Hada'an.

sentences.zh: 大德五年，從戰杭海。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dade he followed the battle at Hanghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Dade he fought at Hanghai.

sentences.zh: 從武宗親征哈剌阿答。

translations.literal: He followed the Wuzong in personally campaigning against Haracha.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied the Wuzong's personal campaign against Haracha.

sentences.zh: 復從創兀兒征不別、八憐，為前鋒，以功受賞賚。

translations.literal: Again he followed Chuangwu'er in campaigning against Bubie and Baling, served as vanguard, and received rewards for merit.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Chuangwu'er against Bubie and Baling, served as vanguard, and was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年，授金符，為千戶。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangqing he was granted the golden tally and made thousand-household commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 2 he received the golden tally and was made a thousand-household commander.

sentences.zh: 明宗居潛邸，延祐四年命從西征，與禿滿帖木兒戰于失剌塔兒馬失之地，以功復受厚賞，居其地十五年。

translations.literal: When the Mingzong dwelt in the hidden residence, in the fourth year of Yanyou he was ordered to follow the western campaign; he fought Tuman Tiemuer at the place Shilata'ermashi; for merit he again received generous reward and dwelt in that land fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: While the Mingzong was still heir apparent, he was ordered west in Yanyou 4, fought Tuman Tiemuer at Shilata'ermashi, received lavish rewards, and remained in that region for fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 天曆二年，賜金符，授昭勇大將軍、同知大都督府事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianli he was granted the golden tally and appointed General of Manifest Courage and vice administrator of the Metropolitan Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 2 he received the golden tally and was made General of Manifest Courage and vice administrator of the Metropolitan Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 脫因納

translations.literal: Tuoyinna
translations.idiomatic: Tuoyinna

sentences.zh: 有子曰定童、只兒哈朗。

translations.literal: He had sons Dingtong and Zhierhalang.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons, Dingtong and Zhierhalang.

sentences.zh: 定童襲父職，阿兒魯萬戶府襄陽萬戶府漢軍達魯花赤，佩金虎符，明威將軍。

translations.literal: Dingtong inherited his father's post as darughachi of the Han army of the Xiangyang Ten-thousand Household Office under the A'erlu Ten-thousand Household Office, bore the golden tiger tally, and was General of Manifest Might.
translations.idiomatic: Dingtong succeeded his father as darughachi of the Han forces of the Xiangyang Ten-thousand Household under the A'erlu command, bearing the golden tiger tally with the rank of General of Manifest Might.

sentences.zh: 只兒哈朗，初授欽察親軍千戶所達魯花赤，佩金符，武略將軍。

translations.literal: Zhierhalang was at first appointed darughachi of the Qincha Imperial Guard Thousand-household Office, bore the golden tally, and was General of Martial Strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhierhalang was first made darughachi of the Qincha Imperial Guard Thousand-household Office with the golden tally and the rank of General of Martial Strategy.

sentences.zh: 改授朝列大夫、通政院副使，歷同知，陞院使，積官中奉大夫。

translations.literal: He was changed to Grand Master of the Court Hierarchy and vice minister of the Communications Bureau; he passed through vice administrator, was raised to bureau chief, and through accumulated offices reached Grand Master for the Promotion of Governance.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Grand Master of the Court Hierarchy and vice minister of the Communications Bureau, served as vice administrator, rose to bureau chief, and eventually reached Grand Master for the Promotion of Governance.

sentences.zh: 和尚，蒙古乃蠻台氏。

translations.literal: Heshang was of the Mongol Naimantai clan.
translations.idiomatic: Heshang belonged to the Mongol Naimantai clan.

sentences.zh: 祖海速，充昔烈木千戶所蒙古軍百戶。

translations.literal: His grandfather Haisu served as hundred-household commander of the Mongol army of the Xiliemu Thousand-household Office.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Haisu had been a hundred-household commander in the Mongol forces of the Xiliemu Thousand-household Office.

sentences.zh: 伯父兀魯不花，初充蒙古軍五十戶。

translations.literal: His father's elder brother Wulubuhua at first served as fifty-household commander of the Mongol army.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Wulubuhua had first served as a fifty-household commander in the Mongol army.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，從昔烈木千戶南征，以功命權百戶，從僉省阿剌海牙攻樊城。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan he followed the Xiliemu thousand-household on the southern campaign; for merit he was ordered acting hundred-household commander and followed Vice Secretariat Alahaiya in attacking Fancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 7 he marched south with the Xiliemu thousand-household, was made acting hundred-household commander for his service, and joined Vice Secretariat Alahaiya at the assault on Fancheng.

sentences.zh: 十一年，從攻新城，又從攻鄂東門，攻處州，屢立戰功。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he followed attacks on Xincheng, again followed attacks on the east gate of E, attacked Chuzhou, and repeatedly established battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he fought at Xincheng, at the east gate of Ezhou, and at Chuzhou, winning repeated distinction in battle.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，賜銀符，授敦武校尉、後衛親軍百戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was granted the silver tally and appointed Martial Corrector of Diligent Valor and hundred-household commander of the Rear Guard Imperial Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he received the silver tally and was made Martial Corrector of Diligent Valor and hundred-household commander of the Rear Guard Imperial Army.

sentences.zh: 是年秋卒。

translations.literal: That autumn he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died that autumn.

sentences.zh: 父怯烈吉襲。

translations.literal: His father Qielieji succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His father Qielieji succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 怯烈吉卒，和尚襲。

translations.literal: When Qielieji died, Heshang succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Qielieji died, Heshang succeeded to the post.
